## ID conventions
- `VDS-Cxx` thesis concept/coinage · `VDS-Pxx` claim/position/move · `VDS-Txx` tension/open-question

## Reuse-disposition tags
`keep-verbatim` · `re-ground` (same insight, new frame) · `enrich` (add RODA layer) · `supersede` (replace w/ stronger RODA construct) · `drop`

## Frame extraction (templated; finalized after ffprobe)
```
ffmpeg -i "<clip>" -vf fps=<F> -q:v 3 gg-frames/f_%05d.jpg
```
Uniform `F` across clip (dense); supplementary higher-rate pass within the two key windows once their timestamps are located in the first trace.
